agent_priors_used: General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): long-horizon autonomous agents accumulate error and context cost, so a capability that cannot be shown to reduce fully-loaded cost per verified safe success against a strong baseline is a maintenance liability, not an asset.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a single-vantage, single-window measurement is a classic external-validity trap; replication at an independent source vantage is the cheapest way to distinguish a real mechanism from an environment artifact.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): independently authored held-out surfaces (new goal bank plus new synonym lexicon, authored without access to the fitted vocabulary) are the strongest practical defense against overfitting a resolver/classifier to its own fixtures.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): information-theoretic ceilings pin retention-only policies at (K-1)/K the moment the required knowledge is not present in the scored session, so a certified non-ceiling separation on a credential-free bank is a real instrument even before a capable agent exists.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): idle parallel capacity has opportunity cost; an idle lane should be pointed at the highest-value unblocked question rather than left dormant or re-run on a completed thread.
General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): provenance/allowlist control of an ingestion surface usually trades safe coverage against false-accept risk, so the decision is empirical, not assumed.

allocation.question: On a credential-free, locally served, perturbable HTTP substrate engineered so that network fetches - not model calls - are the scarce accounting resource, with the shipped parameterized carrier held fixed (src/spider/kernel.py: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify) and the freshness-guard probe observation reused so retrieval/verification are not double-charged: does signal-driven local repair achieve a net end-to-end cost per successful task strictly below cold re-derivation under the registered equal-weight product counter (ratio < 1.00 at L=2 and L=3), or is the observed ~5.3% product-counter regression at L=3 (and >1.0 at L=2) intrinsic to localized repair, such that local repair must be dropped from the product story before the flagship benchmark is funded?
allocation.rationale: Runtime is IDLE with no active experiment; its B2 substrate thread is complete (EXP-RUNTIME-38194351940, ROBUST, audit PASS) and the mandate stop rule forbids iterating banks or re-running the same thread, so leaving it dormant would waste parallel capacity. C-DELTA-REPAIR is an owner claim (graph/runtime/product) that Runtime has never worked and whose last audited result (EXP-GRAPH-38197849043, audit PASS, MIXED-TRADEOFF) explicitly routes this exact fork to the Global Research Director: functional (12/12 repair under the shipped carrier) and local (contamination 0/48) but NOT strictly cheaper on the registered equal-weight counter (ratio 1.1111 at L=2, 1.0526 at L=3, 1.0 at L=4) while fetches alone are cheaper (ratio 0.6667-0.7778). Decision counterfactual: if repair wins net on a fetch-scarce surface, local repair earns a maintenance cost term and may enter the product; if the regression is intrinsic, local repair is dropped before the flagship benchmark is funded - either branch changes a product decision. Strongest fair baseline is B-COLD (success 1.0), never the B-NO-REPAIR abstention or the fetch ratio quoted alone. Smallest decisive batch: one substrate class, cold budgets L in {2,3,4}, shipped carrier frozen; budget/stop trigger is the predeclared counter ratio (no re-weighting or re-tuning the counter after outcomes). This is a Runtime substrate/economics measurement, not the gated C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark execution.

Four lanes already hold correct, unfinished transactions and are therefore CONTINUEd without churn: Frontier's persistence-maintenance economics is FROZEN and must complete; Graph's independently-authored held-out generalization test for C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is PREFREEZE and directly attacks the one leg its prior experiments left unsupported; Intel is FROZEN on the B3 capability bar; Physics is PREFREEZE on the named orthogonal source-vantage factor for the S1_STATIONARY result with an explicit fail-loud path if a second egress cannot be provisioned; Product is PREFREEZE on widening the shipped carrier's certified-safe declaration class, the one carrier-forward question not gated by B3. The liveness gap is Runtime, which is IDLE with no active experiment: its B2 thread is complete and the mandate stop rule forbids iterating banks, so I reactivate it on a neglected owner claim (C-DELTA-REPAIR) whose last audited result is a MIXED-TRADEOFF that leaves a concrete, cheap, decision-determining fork - does signal-driven local repair become net end-to-end cheaper than cold re-derivation on a substrate where fetches rather than model calls are scarce, or is the ~5.3% product-counter regression intrinsic and local repair should be dropped from the product story before the flagship benchmark is funded. No expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution is allocated, because readiness condition (3) is still missing; the portfolio instead finishes B3 (Intel), strengthens B1's safe applicability (Product) and resolves an unblocked maintenance-economics fork (Runtime). Audit friction remains high (13 MEASUREMENT_INVALID and 10 REVISE in the last 60 finalized packets), so every allocation is bounded to a single decisive measurement rather than a new search.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (model unavailable, rc=124); no external reconnaissance or synthesis is available this cycle, so the brief contains only the machine's candidate directions (which mirror the four active mandates), an empty external-context list and a stalled/idle lane list.
